verdict.rationale: Trivy is an open-source CLI/binary distributed via Homebrew, Docker images, and GitHub, and probe evidence confirms local installation and execution (`brew install trivy`, `trivy --version`, `trivy fs` scans) with no SaaS dependency — the entire core product runs self-hosted on the user's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: no dedicated 'self-hosting deployment guide' or server-mode configuration docs beyond CLI/binary install instructions.
